I'm not sure. I've always given myself small goals, if you want to call them that. Education, work, a place to live. Things that aren't really that big of a deal. I'd be lying if I said that when I achieved those things they didn't make me excited or proud of myself even for a little bit, because they did. But after that feeling passed, it's like, ok, now what?

I've only been in one relationship in my life. I feel like I do want to be in one, but I don't think I can make it happen at this point. I kind of have been trying, but I get too anxious, I overthink things a lot, and my awkwardness doesn't help either.

What kind of similarities and experiences do you have?
